free_tier.stated: 5 GB per transfer, no sign-up, 7 days, and the free plan is explicitly labelled 'No storage'. Premium €6/mo = 250 GB/transfer, 365 days, 1 TB storage. A separate API/SDK tier advertises up to 5 TB per file with 365-day retention on a 14-day free trial.

retention.stated: A separate API/SDK tier advertises up to 5 TB per file with 365-day retention on a 14-day free trial

record.tooling: REST API + SDK exist (https://www.transfernow.net/en/discover/transfernow-api-sdk). Multipart, notifications, but behind a paid/14-day-trial plan.
record.chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free 7-day transfers. Not storage: the free row literally says 'No storage'.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 5 GB free. Retention: 7 days free (365 paid). request-rate: not published. The '5 TB per file' figure belongs to the paid API tier, not to free.
record.reliability_note: Clean, honest pricing page. The free tier is a transfer service only. No free path to durability.

API block: 'Up to 5 TB per file - Files kept up to 365 days ... 14-day free trial'
